# Asset listing

Name, size, frames, fps, meaning and frame-index formula for every asset.

<!-- ui:begin -->

## Non-character art (generated by `tools/art/build_ui.py`, do not edit by hand)

All assets are RGBA PNGs in `assets/raw/ui/`, listed in `assets/ui.json`. Alpha is 0 or 255 only (0 = transparent, index 0 in the packed palette). Every opaque color is an exact RGB565 value from the Moonlit Grimoire palette. Frame sets are multi-frame assets; `fps` 0 means a still or index-selected set.

### Usage notes

- Card faces are the interior of the card inside the 2-px rim: blit at (card_x + 2, card_y + 2); card sizes are 48x64 and 40x54. The UI draws the 2-px rim (ink edge ring + rarity color), stars (`ui_star`, top-right, first star at card (W-8, 5), 6 px pitch) and the charm gem (`ui_gem`, bottom-right at card (W-12, H-12)).
- Baked in a face: number or numeral (top-left, card baseline (5, 13) big / (5, 12) small; Ace shows A), 1-px filigree line with corner studs, art plate (32x32 big, 26x26 small, gold edge), element icon bottom-left, and for Reversed cards a small down triangle at bottom center. Majors show the Roman numeral instead of a number.
- Scrap faces carry no number: draw it as text, color rat3 on the rat1 field, at card (5, 12) big / (5, 11) small (baseline). Bite dents are baked into the right edge; the UI draws a rat2 rim (ink edge rat0).
- Transparent pixels (alpha 0) exist in card interiors (four corners), icons, fx_*, ui_btn, ui_moon_eye, ui_node; bg_*, ui_plaque_fight, ui_star_dust and card_back* (except corners) are fully opaque.
- Python constants are the upper-cased names (`assets.CARD_U`, `assets.UI_ELEM`, ...), frame = index formula above.

### Coordinates for composed screens

- `bg_attic` (480x232): wall `night1` (0x2929); floor strip y 196-231 is flat `night0` (0x1044) with only a 1-px `gold0` edge on y 196; hero feet at y 222. Domino zone x 24-172, enemy zone x 268-472. To erase a sprite restore with `asset_region(BG_ATTIC, 0, x, y, x, y, w, h)` (always exact); a flat `night0` fill is also exact for the part of a sprite rectangle below y 197. The top 30 rows are flat `night1` (the UI plate covers them).
- `bg_title`: the menu band y 232-319 is flat `night1`. Logo, moon and window occupy y 0-231.
- `bg_parlor`: floor band y 232-319 is flat dark wood (`night0`); Granny Oriel and the table are baked. Nine Bells rail: draw `ui_bell` (14x16) frame 0/1 at these top-left positions: (292,66), (312,66), (332,66), (352,66), (372,66), (392,66), (412,66), (432,66), (452,66). The rail art underneath is baked for all nine hooks.
- `bg_path`: top band y 0-47 flat `night1` (UI title). Step sockets (ring r=11, `ui_node` 20x20 centers on them): x = [44, 106, 168, 230, 292, 354] for steps 0-5, boss socket x = 428 (ring r=15); road y = 168; the two choice rings of a step sit at (x, 128) and (x, 208); dotted connectors are baked.
- `bg_end`: text band y 236-319 flat `night1`.

## Characters (generated by `tools/art/characters.py`; PixelLab calls in `tools/art/characters_gen.py`)

Manifest: `assets/characters.json` (packed by `tools/pack_assets.py` as `NAME`, `NAME_portrait`, `NAME_<anim>`).
Frames live in `assets/raw/characters/<name>/` (`base.png`, `idle_NN.png`, `attack_NN.png`, `portrait.png`).
Cached PixelLab outputs: `assets/raw/characters/_src/` (never regenerated unless `--force`).

Rules: Moonlit palette (RGB565-exact), 1-bit alpha, at most 15 colors per character (4bpp storage), feet on the bottom row
of the canvas (put the canvas bottom on the floor line), Domino/Zero/Granny Oriel face right, every rat and Chubbs face
left. Hurt (tint flash + shake) and defeat (sink + silhouette) are done in code by UIKit; no frames exist for them.
Portraits are 48x48 RGB head crops on `night0`.
